newsitem.title: USA: D.R. Horton Q2 net new sales orders jump.
newsitem.headline: D.R. Horton Q2 net new sales orders jump.

text.p: D.R. Horton Inc on Wednesday reported the highest quarterly new sales orders in company history with a 25 percent increase in net sales contracts signed during the three months ended March 31, 1997 over the year-ago period.

Net new sales contracts for the second quarter of fiscal 1997 totaled 1,281 homes ($212.4 million), compared with 1,028 homes ($174.9 million) a year ago. Its backlog of homes under contract at March 31, 1997, was the highest in company history and rose 42 percent to 1,841 homes ($324.5 million) from 1,298 homes ($225.9 million) at March 31, 1996.

Net new sales contracts for the first six months of fiscal 1997 increased 18 percent, totaling 2,032 homes ($342.1 million) compared with 1,727 homes ($290.3 million) for the same period of fiscal 1996.

Donald R. Horton, chairman and president, said, "The late February acquisition of the Torrey Group and our record level sales backlog at March 31, 1997, places the company in an excellent position for the remainder of fiscal 1997."
D.R. Horton Inc is engaged in the construction and sale of high-quality, single-family homes with custom features designed principally for the entry- level and move-up markets.
